items.title: Trump Jr.-backed 1789 Capital set to invest 300 million dollars in Polymarket in reported 1 billion dollar round at 21 billion dollar valuation, BitRss reports
items.content_text: - **Trump Jr.-backed 1789 Capital set to invest 300 million dollars in Polymarket in reported 1 billion dollar round at 21 billion dollar valuation, BitRss reports** — BitRss, citing a Wall Street Journal report, said 1789 Capital, where Donald Trump Jr. is a partner, is set to invest about 300 million dollars in Polymarket as part of a reported 1 billion dollar fundraising round that could value the platform at 21 billion dollars. items.title: Senators Curtis and Schiff ask CFTC to investigate Polymarket over alleged deceptive influencer marketing, BitRss reports
items.content_text: - **Senators Curtis and Schiff ask CFTC to investigate Polymarket over alleged deceptive influencer marketing, BitRss reports** — Republican Senator John Curtis and Democratic Senator Adam Schiff wrote to CFTC Chair Mike Selig asking the agency to investigate Polymarket over allegations it paid social media influencers to promote fake bets without clear disclosure. The letter follows a Wall Street Journal review of more than 1,100 promotional videos that found 70 percent included fake bets totaling nearly 2 million dollars; Polymarket said it is auditing its promotional content for compliance. ([BitRss](https://bitrss.com/us-senators-ask-cftc-to-investigate-polymarket-s-deceptive-marketing-225732))

items.title: Kentucky sues Kalshi and Polymarket over sports betting contracts and names Coinbase, Robinhood and Webull, BitRss reports
items.content_text: - **Kentucky sues Kalshi and Polymarket over sports betting contracts and names Coinbase, Robinhood and Webull, BitRss reports** — Kentucky filed lawsuits against five prediction market platforms including Kalshi and Polymarket, and also named Kalshi partners Coinbase, Robinhood and Webull, alleging the platforms are operating sports wagering in the state without required authorization. The complaints add to a broader set of state challenges arguing sports event contracts are unlicensed gambling, while the operators argue the products are swaps under CFTC jurisdiction. items.title: Canada limits regulated prediction markets to economic, environmental and financial contracts, BitcoinCasinos reports
items.content_text: - **Canada limits regulated prediction markets to economic, environmental and financial contracts, BitcoinCasinos reports** — Under joint guidance from CIRO and the Canadian Securities Administrators issued August 27, authorized Canadian dealers may offer only event contracts tied to economic forecasts, environmental indicators and financial markets with a minimum 30-day maturity, while election and political contracts remain prohibited. Wealthsimple and Interactive Brokers Canada are the only CIRO dealer members authorized to offer such contracts. items.content_text: - **Brennan Center study finds prediction market odds sway voters by 10 to 20 points, Casino.org reports** — A Brennan Center study of 1,994 registered voters conducted September 21 found a candidate favored by prediction markets gains a 10 to 20 percentage point boost in perceived victory regardless of polling, while low odds reduce perceived viability by 11 to 19 points. items.content_text: - **Kalshi sues Louisiana attorney general to block state gambling enforcement against its sports event contracts, SportsBettingDime reports** — Kalshi filed suit against Louisiana and Attorney General Liz Murrill seeking a temporary restraining order and preliminary and permanent injunctions, arguing the Commodity Exchange Act gives the CFTC exclusive jurisdiction over its event contracts. items.title: Polymarket US logs record 74 million trades in October, CryptoBriefing reports
items.content_text: - **Polymarket US logs record 74 million trades in October, CryptoBriefing reports** — Polymarket US processed more than 74 million trades in October, a 15 percent jump from September, with monthly active traders reaching an all-time high of approximately 478,000. Sports drove the surge, with NFL and college football leading and combo and parlay-style contracts launched in August accounting for more than 50 percent of activity in some weeks, while one October week recorded 2.82 billion dollars in notional volume. ([CryptoBriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/polymarket-us-record-74-million-trades-october/))

items.title: Prediction markets need one federal rulebook as courts split over state versus CFTC oversight, NetChoice reports
items.content_text: - **Prediction markets need one federal rulebook as courts split over state versus CFTC oversight, NetChoice reports** — NetChoice argues prediction markets need a single federal rulebook, noting CNN and CNBC now carry Kalshi data on election night and federal courts are divided over whether the markets are financial markets overseen by Washington or gambling regulated by each state. The Supreme Court has been asked to decide, and Pew Research Center found monthly volume on the two largest platforms grew more than fivefold between September 2025 and April 2026. ([NetChoice](https://netchoice.org/prediction-markets-need-one-rulebook/))
